'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Matt Wehner LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Wehner]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
